coverageSpotVerification.detail: Lane coverage manifests (evidence/m{1,2,3,4,5,6,8}-coverage.json; none at the lane root) map all 58 suite-required M1-M6/M8 IDs with no missing or extra IDs. For each sampled ID the mapped test (scripts/acceptance.mjs, test-m2..m8.mjs) exercises the observable. Weak but honest: m2-a16 checks attribution via the API (the UI label is a harness observable); m3-a11 jump check can pass when the original is already loaded (scripts/quote-page-proof.mjs covers the unloaded case); m2-a22..a24 depend on residue (d-02). No mapping claims an observable its test does not touch. Suite runs from the grader clean checkout: all pass except the first M2 run (m2-a22..a24).

defects.summary: Prefix search is truncated for broad terms. When a first term matches more than 32 distinct words in a scope (the published snapback4 0.2.29 expansion bound), in-chat, all-messages, and people search return a partial page (complete:false, cut:"words") with no continuation, not newest-first. Probe: 45 distinct kx* words gave 20 of 45 hits and no next cursor. The UI shows an incomplete-results notice; the lane disclosed the bound in platform-gaps.md. This breaks the brief's paginated newest-first prefix search for common short prefixes at realistic corpus sizes.

The documented acceptance entrypoint is not reproducible from a clean checkout for M2. After the documented setup (backend, seed m1-m3), the first `npm run acceptance -- --milestone m2` failed both-feeds-paginate-uniquely (assert pages>1): Bob's Following held 19 entries, because the test seeds no >20-post Following fixture and depends on earlier-run residue. A second run passed. Product pagination itself is correct (m2-a22..a24 pass under grader execution).

Intermittent Following-feed projection error. In the frozen harness sequence (Bob unfollows Alice, then immediately reposts her post from Global), Alice's original appeared in Bob's Following as a direct follow hit. The harness failed 'viewer-repost of an unfollowed author was counted as a direct follow-projection hit' in 2 of 3 grader attempts and 8 of 12 attempts across the lane's four retained M2 receipts. It passed best-of-3 only via an attempt that started unfollowed. Four grader reproductions (fresh accounts and Alice/Bob, 250 ms sampling for 10 s) did not reproduce it, so it is intermittent/state-dependent.

Every video shows the same unrelated bundled fixture photo as its poster/thumbnail. src/social.tsx (feed cards), src/message.tsx (video bubbles), and src/media.tsx (native picks) require("../fixtures/media/img-01.png"), so the app bundle ships a test fixture as a UI placeholder and misrepresents video content.

The 'This chat' scope on the Search screen, reached without a chat parameter, silently searches the hard-coded fixture conversation 'd-alice-bob' (src/search.tsx: conversationId: String(params.chat ?? 'd-alice-bob')). Non-members get 0 results and Alice/Bob get the wrong chat.
defects.evidence: trace.md#E15 (This-chat scope returned 0 for a user with matching messages); src/search.tsx

defects.summary: Hard global capacity caps sized to the fixture envelope in snapback/feed.q refuse writes beyond it. feedPosts total 60,000; feedFollows total 20,000; a reader can pull at most 32 shared (>50-follower) authors (FEED_PULL_CAP); and an author crossing 50 followers can refuse a new follower because another follower's slots are full (FEED_PROMOTION_PULL_CAP). Latent: not reached at the graded envelope (replay passed); the README acknowledges envelope-selected caps.

The documented run posture is `snapback4 dev`. Its loopback, unauthenticated POST /dev/clock/advance moves server time (the grader used it on an isolated instance to age a post 25 h), so any local process can bypass edit/delete/expiry windows on the documented deployment. The platform refuses this seam under release/serve, which the README recommends for production. Mutation arguments never accept caller timestamps (E_INPUT).
defects.evidence: trace.md#E11 (advance response); trace.md#E5; backend.log dev banner in trace.md#E0

defects.summary: The duplicate-email signup error shows a raw platform code: 'Error: E_AUTH: that email already has an account; sign in instead'.

Search results use conversationId as the React key, so several hits in one chat collide. The web console logs "Encountered two children with the same key", with a risk of stale or merged rows on update.

O1.justification: 101 of 119 assertions pass under grader execution. M1-M5 pass in full; M6 and M8 pass on web and API; all M8 grader-class digest items pass. Not passed: 9 native-artifact assertions (m6-a01..a07, m8-a17/a18) with no simulator proof, and M7 (9 assertions) not attempted, which stays in the full-run denominator. Well above the 60 anchor (later milestones are solid, not patchy) but short of 90 (platform-proof artifacts missing, one milestone not run). Coverage honest; no dishonest-mapping adjudication. Evidence: trace.md#E1, #E2, #E4-#E21.

O2.anchorsCited: Between ~60 ('a few medium defects off the happy path') and ~90 ('only cosmetic nits'); nearer 60.
O2.justification: No blocker, no crash, no data loss. One major off-happy-path defect: broad-prefix search truncated with no continuation (d-01). Minor: M2 suite not reproducible from clean (d-02), intermittent Following projection after unfollow+repost (d-03), static fixture video posters (d-04), hard-coded default chat in the This-chat search scope (d-05), envelope-sized global caps (d-06), dev-posture clock seam (d-07). Cosmetic: raw error code text (d-08), duplicate React keys (d-09). Core flows under independent API, web, and harness execution returned correct data.

O3.anchorsCited: Near ~90 ('every probe correctly denied, including asset access after view-once/delete'); well above ~60 ('core reads protected; a secondary probe (e.g., expired-window edit) succeeds when it shouldn't').
O3.justification: PROVISIONAL and non-holdout: no probe set was committed for this wave (probeSetSha256 none-uncommitted), so O3 cannot rest on rotated holdout probes as the frozen rule requires. It is scored from the grader's own trust-boundary checklist executions, one or more per published category. tb-cross-user-dm-access: non-member history/search/roster empty, message null, send/ack/configure NOT_MEMBER, asset 404. tb-removed-member-delivery: removed member gets no new rows, send NOT_MEMBER. tb-view-once-refetch: 410 E_ASSET_VIEWED. tb-expired-edit-window: EDIT_WINDOW_CLOSED at +66 s, timestamp args E_INPUT. tb-session-invalidation: 401 E_AUTH after logout. tb-offline-bypass: expired message purged from offline search; consumed view-once not reopenable offline and deleted media tombstoned on web. tb-digest-authorization: non-member, removed-member, and tombstoned activity excluded. Held below 90: offline bypass was not demonstrable natively, and the documented dev posture exposes an unauthenticated loopback clock seam (d-07). Evidence: trace.md#E4, #E5, #E8, #E9, #E16.

O4.anchorsCited: Below ~30 ('cold-start offline shows an empty or broken app'); the native proof needed to reach ~60 or ~90 does not exist.
O4.justification: O4 is applicable (M6 green) but reads only mechanically checkable simulator artifacts. None exist for M6 or M8 (no recording, native receipts, or run manifest); harness supplementalExternal records ios-simulator-m6/m8 pass:null not-recorded. The lane ships Hermes exports only and says it does not claim simulator execution. That honest disclosure of the gap, plus web-harness evidence that cannot substitute (web queue flush in order, M8 multi-device convergence and dual-offline settle), earns a small amount above 0. Evidence: trace.md#E21, #E2.

O5.bandRationale: First-match order 0,30,60,90,75. Branch 0 did not fire: the grader independently re-counted the post-replay scale store (read-only copy) and all 14 per-entity counts and every named O5 fixture equal invariant-manifest-combined.json (u0500 500 follows/100 chats, u0005 5, u0900 900 followers/200 posts, u0901 follows exactly u0001-u0004+u0900, g0001 50 members/10,000 messages). The builder's 10%/50% checkpoint verifications also passed. The replay wall cap is an uncalibrated placeholder and cannot have been exhausted (replay 4103 s on its own clock). Branch 30 did not fire: the recorded builder probes show no error or timeout, following-500/following-5 p95 ratio ~1.0 at all checkpoints, celebrity-follower/following-5 ~0.96, and chat and all-message search 100%/10% p95 of 0.89 and 0.91 with the 50% point below the line. Branch 60 cannot fire (no calibrated ceilings or cap) and branch 90 cannot be established (no ceiling utilization or cap fraction), so 75 is the total fall-through. PROVISIONAL: no wave probe set was committed and the replay record lacks page-50 vs page-1 deep paging, celebrity write-path p95, receipt-aggregation stall, cold-start replica sync wall time, and 10%/50% Insights/Trending points (measured at the final corpus only). The grader ran no holdout performance probes (phase 4 skipped).
